subject: Trace export mechanics and retention: admin activity evidence for SIG/CAIQ
messages:
From: HealthFin Compliance <compliance@healthfin.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 7 Jun 2025 09:12:05 -0700
Subject: Request: admin activity export for SIG/CAIQ assessment - Q1 2025

Hi Vanessa,

We're preparing HealthFin's SIG/CAIQ and need an evidence bundle for admin activity (console + operator actions) covering 2025-03-01 through 2025-05-31. Specifically we need:

- The exact schema/fields captured for each admin event (actor, role, action, timestamp with TZ, resource id, request_id, session_id, source IP, outcome, related model_version/endpoint).
- Retention windows and any tier differences (hosted vs dedicated vs private).
- Export formats you can produce (ndjson, csv, parquet) and compression options.
- Integrity and delivery options: signed manifests, checksums (sha256), HMAC signing, KMS-wrapped envelopes, SFTP vs presigned S3.
- Sampling strategy if full export is >10TB (we'd accept a statistically valid 30-day sample and a proof of completeness manifest).

We're on a fairly tight SOC 2 timeline. Can you confirm what you can provide and any constraints? I've attached the SIG section that references admin activity for context.

Thanks,
Claire Ramos
Head of Compliance, HealthFin
Compliance Team <compliance@healthfin.com>
Attachments: SIG_questionnaire_section_admin_activity.pdf (pdf)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: HealthFin Compliance <compliance@healthfin.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 7 Jun 2025 10:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity export for SIG/CAIQ assessment - Q1 2025

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear ask and the SIG excerpt.

Short answer: we can provide a production-grade export that meets SIG/SOC2 evidence expectations; below is a concise summary and a couple of clarifying questions so we scope the bundle correctly.

What we log (high level):
- Event envelope: timestamp (RFC3339TZ), request_id, actor_id, actor_role, tenant_id, action (enum), resource_type/id, outcome (success/fail/error_code), source_ip, user_agent, session_id, request_latency_ms, api_endpoint, model_version, operator_tool (console vs API).
- We do NOT include full user-submitted payloads by default (we log request metadata and identifiers only). If you need payload retention as evidence, we should discuss data minimization and redaction.

Retention summary (defaults):
- Hosted (standard): 90 days operational retention; snapshots available for SOC/Audit requests on a timeboxed basis.
- Dedicated: contractual default 540 days (can be extended per enterprise contract).
- Private: retention is customer-configurable; we'll follow the customer's retention policy and can produce exports from on-prem or VPC storage if you provide access.

Export options we can produce immediately:
- NDJSON gzipped (.ndjson.gz) with a top-level manifest (manifest.json) listing files, sha256 checksums, record counts, time range, and a high-watermark.
- Parquet (snappy) on request for analytics-friendly ingestion.
- CSV for selected, flattened subsets (not recommended for full fidelity).

Integrity & delivery:
- Manifest: JSON manifest with per-file sha256 and a manifest-level signature (HMAC-SHA256) we can sign.
- Key exchange: recommended via an ephemeral KMS-wrapped envelope (we can provide RSA/PGP public key support for customers who prefer).
- Delivery: presigned S3 (us-east-1) or SFTP push. For very large bundles we can provide staged multipart upload links or ship an encrypted disk under controlled chain-of-custody.

Sampling: if full export exceeds agreed thresholds we can produce a statistically valid sample (we use reservoir sampling for low-latency slices or time-windowed sampling for contiguous evidence). We'll include sampling seeds and the hash method in the manifest so you can reproduce/validate the sample.

Attachments: redwood_admin_event_manifest_v1.json (schema), export_playbook.pdf (export checklist).

Clarifying Qs:
1) Do you want operator-only events (privileged console/operator actions) or all admin-level activity (includes API tokens and role changes)?
2) Any special compliance on timezone normalization (we default to UTC in the manifest but keep local tz in the raw events)?
3) Preferred delivery method (S3 presigned vs SFTP)?

If helpful I can provision a 3-day test bundle (NDJSON gzip) tomorrow for review. I also put a few times on my calendar: https://cal.com/vanessa/30 — happy to hop on a short call to walk through the manifest.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_admin_event_manifest_v1.json (json), export_playbook.pdf (pdf)

From: Lauren Briggs <l.briggs@auditworks.co>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, HealthFin Compliance <compliance@healthfin.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 7 Jun 2025 12:00:35 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity export for SIG/CAIQ assessment - Q1 2025

Vanessa / Claire — quick clarifications from the auditor side so we can map requirements to your export spec: 

- For integrity we require sha256 checksums on each file plus a manifest-level HMAC. We will request the HMAC key exchange workflow; KMS envelope is fine provided we get an attestation of key wrapping.
- Sampling: the audit will accept a 30-day contiguous sample if the manifest proves completeness (file hashes + counts + high-watermark). We also want the method for selecting the contiguous window documented in the manifest.
- Timezone: all timestamps should be normalized to UTC in the canonical export; local tz may be provided as a secondary field.
- Payloads: confirm that full request/response bodies are not in the export by default. If HealthFin requires payloads for forensics, we need a redaction plan and PII control.

I've attached an internal checklist for mapping SIG controls to exported fields.

Lauren Briggs
Senior IT Auditor, AuditWorks
Attachments: audit_requirements_checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Briggs <l.briggs@auditworks.co>, HealthFin Compliance <compliance@healthfin.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 8 Jun 2025 08:22:44 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity export for SIG/CAIQ assessment - Q1 2025

Hi Claire / Lauren — thanks for the notes. Confirming scope and next steps below.

Scope confirmation: operator & privileged-admin events only (we will exclude general application request telemetry and user-content payloads unless you request them in writing).

Export plan (what we'll deliver as a test bundle):
- 3-day contiguous test bundle (2025-05-25 -> 2025-05-27) in NDJSON gz (.ndjson.gz).
- One manifest.json (top-level) listing: file_name, sha256, record_count, start_ts, end_ts, sampling_method ("none" for the test), and high_watermark_request_id.
- Manifest-level HMAC-SHA256 using an ephemeral key; key exchange via AWS KMS envelope (we will provide the wrapped key and our KMS key id; HealthFin can provide a public key if preferred).
- Timezone: canonical timestamps will be UTC (RFC3339); event.local_tz will be included as an optional field for cross-checks.

Delivery: presigned S3 (7-day expiry). For production evidence handoff we can move to SFTP with signed delivery receipts if you need longer retention windows on the receiving side.

Next actions:
- I'll send the test bundle link by EOD PDT today to the email on this thread.
- Kimberly will prepare a short attestation note describing retention policy differences (hosted vs dedicated) and the chain-of-custody language.
- Can we confirm a 30-minute call Monday to review the test bundle? I've included a scheduling link: https://cal.com/vanessa/30

Attachments: test_export_instructions.txt (txt) — contains the manifest example and verification steps.

Thanks — we'll aim to make the export verifiable by your audit tooling.

Vanessa Ortiz
